Game Overview

Urban Sniper 3D is a shooter title where silent precision meets urban chaos in Urban Sniper 3D. As a lone marksman, strategically target enemies hidden within a bustling cityscape. Harness your sniper skills, maintain stealth, and disrupt the hostile plot before it's too late. Experience the thrill of pinpoint accuracy and dynamic city environments.
